title: Vending machine
prompt: a snack vending machine: insert a coin, type a code on the keypad, the spiral turns and the snack drops to the tray; see-through shows the coin mech, spiral motors, drop sensor and refrigeration
blurb: Drop in coins and punch a code: the spiral turns once, your snack tips off the end, falls through an infrared beam into the bin, and the change rattles down to the cup.
